The '''2015–16 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team''' represented [[Vanderbilt University]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was [[Kevin Stallings]]' 17th and final year as the Vanderbilt head coach. The Commodores played their home games at [[Memorial Gymnasium (Vanderbilt University)|Memorial Gymnasium]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]], as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 19–14, 11–7 in SEC play to finish in a three way tie for third place. They lost in the second round of the [[2016 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2015–16 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the First Four to [[2015–16 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]].

On March 27, 2016, head coach Kevin Stallings resigned to become the head coach at [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]].<ref>{{cite web| url = https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/Pitt/2016/03/27/Sources-say-Vanderbilt-s-Kevin-Stallings-offered-Pitt-men-s-basketball-job/stories/201603270181| title = Vanderbilt's Kevin Stallings hired as Pitt men's basketball coach {{!}} Pittsburgh Post-Gazette}}</ref> He finished at Vanderbilt with a 17-year record of 332–220. Shortly thereafter, the school hired Valparaiso head coach Bryce Drew as head coach.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/15140517/vanderbilt-commodores-hire-bryce-drew-valparaiso-crusaders-new-coach|title=Vandy hires coach Bryce Drew from Valparaiso|work=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-08-15}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2014–15 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|2014–15 Commodores]] finished the season 21–14, 9–9 in SEC play to finish at seventh place in the SEC standings. As the #7 seed, they lost in the second round of the [[2015 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2014–15 Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball team|Tennessee]]. Vanderbilt participated in the [[2015 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as an #5 seed, defeating [[2014–15 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] and [[2014–15 South Dakota State Jackrabbits men's basketball team|South Dakota State]] before falling to the eventual NIT champion, the [[2014–15 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Stanford Cardinal]], in the quarterfinals, marking the end of the Commodores' season.
